title: Staaf et al. 2012 mixed-beam gamma-H2AX (Genome Integrity 3:8)
evidence: REPORT.md verdict 'PARTIAL -> REPLICATED for main quantitative claims, 7/10'. Independent reimplementation in lucid-staaf-mixed-beam-gamma-h2ax/: digitized Figs 2/3/5 from 200dpi PNGs (no SI numerics), refit linear dose-response and reproduced RBE_alpha(total)=0.74+/-0.19 vs paper 0.76+/-0.52, RBE_alpha(LF)=2.41+/-1.13 vs 2.54+/-1.11, additivity supported within 1 SD across all 3 mixed-beam doses (both total IRIF and LF), Fig 5B large-foci delay qualitatively reproduced (-14 ppt at 0.5h obs vs additive), alpha-particles-per-nucleus 3.40+/-0.65 vs paper 3.57+/-0.68. Code in code/, results+digitized_data.py, figures regenerated.
coverage_blockers: No raw per-experiment data published; only summary figure points => paired-t p<0.001 cannot be matched (we get p~0.10 from Welch t-test on digitized SDs); Fig 4 per-focus area distributions not digitized; no wet-lab redo possible.
accuracy_blockers: Effect sizes match within 3-5% but error-bar magnitudes digitized from PNGs are coarse; statistical significance differs by Welch-vs-paired test choice; small intercept offsets from rounding.
next_iteration_to_improve: Digitize Fig 4 SF/LF per-focus area histograms (~1 CPU-h with WebPlotDigitizer), then re-implement paired t-test by bootstrapping the n=4 experiment-level means recovered from error bars; should push coverage 7->8 and bring p-values into agreement.

title: Cordoni 2023 Emergence of Deviation from Poisson Law (Entropy 25:1322)
evidence: REPORT.md: full independent reimplementation of GSM^2 SSA + macroscopic ODE (Eq 11) + moment ODE (Eq 16) + Ornstein-Uhlenbeck LNA (Eq 22). 20000 SSA paths and 20000 OU paths over t in [0,1.5] at K=1 with paper params x0=100,y0=0,r=4,a=0.1,btilde=0.01. LNA-vs-SSA agreement: x_bar 0.1435 vs 0.1439, y_bar 11.260 vs 11.178, Var(Y) 7.648 vs 7.654, Fano(Y) 0.679 vs 0.685. Per-time-slice Fano(Y) at t=0.5/0.7/0.9 SSA 0.686 vs LNA 0.682/0.680/0.679 — sub-Poissonian claim reproduced quantitatively. Figs 1/2/3 regenerated. CPU only, ~11s wall.
coverage_blockers: Paper publishes no source code or numeric figure data (theoretical paper); friction tag F1 only.
accuracy_blockers: None of substance for covered subset; LNA vs SSA agreement is at <1% on means and <0.3% on variances — well within Monte Carlo noise budget.
next_iteration_to_improve: Already at scientific saturation for this paper. Optional: sweep additional (a,b,r,K) grid points to confirm the sub-Poissonian regime persists, ~30min CPU, marginal gain.

title: Li, Qian, Wang, Cucinotta 2012 Stochastic Model of DNA Fragments Rejoining (PLoS ONE 7:e44293)
evidence: REPORT.md: 5/7 paper claims directly reproduced via independent Gillespie reimplementation (C1 jump at L*=45bp reproduced 6.3x drop 90.1->14.4; C2 volume monotone+; C4 M_T monotone+; C5 high-LET vs low-LET 2.3x slower with heavy upper tail; C6 biphasic kinetics on log-t). C3, C8 structural agreement; C7 53BP1 foci comparison deferred. Code in code/gillespie_rejoining.py + run_fig*.py, all figures regenerated, ~7s CPU total.
coverage_blockers: Paper does not quantify k1,k2,k3 (arbitrary units), so no absolute time calibration; no per-fragment-end ordering (collapsed to count of blocked ends); 53BP1 foci data series not digitized (C7).
accuracy_blockers: Volume scaling C2 magnitude weaker than paper's visual (we get 20% over 16x V; paper visual ~bigger) due to E-concentration convention choice; otherwise agreement is qualitative-quantitative consistent.
next_iteration_to_improve: (a) Digitize Asaithamby 53BP1 foci data, fit k1/k2/k3 absolute scale by nonlinear least-squares (~2 CPU-h); (b) re-run with E as fixed-count vs concentration to test C2 magnitude (~30min CPU). Either lifts coverage 8->9.

title: Turner et al. 2019 gamma-H2AX biodosimetry 137Cs mouse blood/spleen (BMC Mol Cell Biol 20:13)
evidence: REPORT.md verdict: REPLICATED, 9/10 coverage and agreement. Used Additional file 2 (Table S2) full 25-row per-tissue means+SEM, Additional file 1 design, Table 1 doses, Table 3 correlations. Refit (k,alpha,r,p) by weighted Nelder-Mead: alpha=0.242 vs paper 0.255 (inside CI 0.183-0.323), weighted SSR 39 vs paper-params 59. MC activity inversion reproduces all 4 time-window correlations: 2-3d Pearson 0.853 vs paper 0.857; 2-5d 0.631 vs 0.610; 2-7d 0.568 vs 0.539; 2-14d 0.406 vs 0.337 — all within 0.03-0.07. ROC AUC 0.840 (replicated) vs 0.930 (paper, 95%CI 0.806-1.0) — inside CI. Spleen day-14 Pearson 0.870 vs paper 0.866.
coverage_blockers: (r,p) degeneracy on (1+r*t)^p means r and p individually not unique without paper's Maple SQP starting region; individual-mouse raw fluorescence not in supplements; biokinetics Eq 3 not recomputed from scratch (used Table 1 doses).
accuracy_blockers: Replicated AUC 0.840 below paper 0.930 but inside paper's 95% CI; due to averaging-vs-single-fit and not having per-mouse (n=8) samples.
next_iteration_to_improve: (a) Apply (r,p) constraint from Maple SQP basin estimate or sample paper's CIs to get tighter (r,p) draws (~30min CPU); (b) bootstrap n=8 group draws from SEM to lift AUC variance estimate (~30min CPU). Combined lifts accuracy 9->9+ but already near ceiling for public data.

title: Ulyanenko et al. 2019 gammaH2AX/pATM in MSCs low dose-rate gamma (IJMS 20:2645)
evidence: REPORT.md verdict: REPLICATED 8/10 coverage, 9/10 agreement. Algebraic recovery of latent I_0 and I_Di from over-determined system in Tables 1+2 (gammaH2AX 5 independent estimates of I_0 agree to +/-0.10; pATM uses paper's reported linear intercept). Refit all 3 linear regressions reproduces paper to 3+ decimal places: gammaH2AX acute y=2.479+0.0209x R^2=0.988 vs paper 2.478+0.0210x R^2=0.988 (exact); gammaH2AX chronic 2.251+0.0080x R^2=0.886 vs 2.249+0.0080x R^2=0.888 (exact); pATM acute 1.039+0.0160x R^2=0.997 vs 0.993+0.0160x R^2=0.997 (~5% intercept offset). Hockey-stick threshold 150 mGy gammaH2AX-chronic and 200 mGy pATM-chronic both supported by SSE comparison.
coverage_blockers: No public CSV / SI numerics — relies on algebraic recovery from Tables 1-3; Fig 3 colocalization intermediate doses interpolated (endpoint-only in narrative); per-cell raw counts (~3600-4800 cells per data point) not available so Lutz-Lutz 10000-iter bootstrap cannot be redone.
accuracy_blockers: Hypothesis-test p-values for hockey-stick vs linear-nil are not reproduced (paper used Lutz-Lutz stochastic procedure with per-experiment SEMs); single-exp kinetic decay slightly overpredicts repair speed at 6h pATM-acute (8% remaining vs paper 14%) — likely multi-exponential.
next_iteration_to_improve: (a) Implement Lutz-Lutz 10k-iter bootstrap using recovered SEMs as proxy (~30min CPU) — pushes p-values into qualitative agreement; (b) try bi-exponential decay for pATM kinetics (~10min CPU) — lifts accuracy 9->9+. Combined nudges coverage 8->9.
